sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their impressive run. Sandbach are in outstanding form with five consecutive wins and sit top of the table on 22 points from 10 games. They face a struggling Alsager Town side anchored at the foot of the division with just 4 points from 10 matches, having won only once this season.
divisionWide: Second-place Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that could see them close the gap on leaders Sandbach if results elsewhere break their way. AFC Bridgnorth, third on 19 points, face a home test against Eccleshall (6th place), with both sides enjoying reasonable recent form. Wolverhampton Casuals host Wednesfield Community in a clash between 4th and 9th respectively, with both capable of climbing further up the table. In-form Bilston Town (5th, W-W-D-W-W) take on Foley Meir at home, while Barnton host Shawbury United—the latter having fallen to five straight defeats and sitting 15th. Market Drayton Town (10th) travel to face New Mills (8th) in a mid-table encounter. Brereton Social are at home to struggling Widnes Town, who have managed just 2 points from 7 games with five defeats in their last six outings. Cheadle Heath Nomads face an away trip to Telford Town in a basement-area duel between two of the division's poorest performers. Crewe host Allscott Heath in a fixture between two struggling sides, with Crewe having won just three of eight games.
